description: Values with characters an engine may interpret reach the server unchanged.

input.scenario: A generation's server.json gives the stdio server the environment values A='!touch /tmp/hcs-canary', B='$HOME', C='${PATH}', and a header-style value D='Bearer {token}' with token a granted secret 's3cr$t'. The server echoes its environment.

expect.behaviour: The server receives A, B and C exactly as written and D as 'Bearer s3cr$t'; /tmp/hcs-canary does not exist.
